decisions.summary: Store the project association as an explicit `project_key` override column on the `conversations` table (name-keyed). Moving NEVER rewrites `cwd` and NEVER touches the JSONL session file on disk. Sidebar grouping prefers the override when set, falling back to cwd→project-path inference when null.

The single backend primitive is `PATCH /api/conversations/:name/move { projectKey }` on the name-keyed `conversations` table (the store the Command Deck sidebar groups on via `listConversations()` → `conv.cwd`). It validates the target project with `getProjectSync()` + path-exists (mirroring the 400 `Unknown project` guard at conversations.ts:1867), is a no-op 200 if already in the target project, sets the override via a new `setConversationProjectKey()`, and emits a `conversation.moved` domain event so all connected clients re-group live.

The CLI `pan conversations move <query> <projectKey>` resolves `<query>` against the live `conversations` table (exact name, then fuzzy title match over `listConversations()`) — NOT the `discovered_sessions` archive that `pan conversations show`/`search` use. Rationale: the move feature re-groups the dashboard sidebar, which is backed by the `conversations` table keyed by `name`; `discovered_sessions` is the on-disk JSONL index keyed by numeric id and has no sidebar project grouping. The command calls the PATCH endpoint via `getDashboardApiUrlSync()` (the same CLI→dashboard pattern as abort-review/reset-review/plan-done) so validation + write + event emission stay in one place.

Moving is allowed regardless of session state (active or ended). Because we only flip the override column and never touch `cwd` or the running tmux process, a live session's working directory is undisturbed; only the sidebar grouping changes.

The 3-dot/right-click `Move` action opens a PROJECT picker (a list of registered projects), with the conversation's current project indicated/disabled. This is the default interpretation of the issue's 'Move -> list' phrasing.

Drag-and-drop uses native HTML5 DnD (draggable row + drop-target project node), following the existing native-DnD precedent in `Stage/PaneBar.tsx`, rather than @dnd-kit. Rationale: the drag crosses two sibling components (ConversationList ↔ ProjectTree) that are not under a shared @dnd-kit `DndContext`; native HTML5 DnD needs no shared provider and keeps the change surgical. Both the menu action and the drop call the same shared `move` React-Query mutation (optimistic re-group + rollback + toast).

A new `pan-conversations` wrapper skill is added under `sync-sources/skills/` documenting the conversations command group including `move`, because `pan conversations` is a user-facing group, is NOT in the SKILLS-CONVENTION exclusion list, and the issue AC explicitly requires the wrapper updated in the same commit. The skill must pass `scripts/lint-skills.sh`.

hazards.summary: JSONL session files are sacred (CLAUDE.md). The override column must leave the on-disk JSONL and the conversation's `cwd` completely untouched — no file move, no path rewrite.
hazards.mitigation: Move writes ONLY the `conversations.project_key` column. Add an explicit acceptance criterion + test asserting the JSONL path and `cwd` are unchanged after a move.

hazards.summary: Other project-scoped behavior that keys off `cwd` (not the sidebar) is intentionally OUT of scope — moving only changes sidebar grouping, not any cwd-based context/automation. Conflating the two would balloon scope.
hazards.mitigation: Document scope boundary in the vBRIEF narrative: only sidebar/Project-Activity grouping reads the override. cwd-based resolution elsewhere is unchanged and explicitly not part of this issue.

hazards.summary: `project_key` must be added to EVERY SELECT column list and the `rowToConversation` mapper in conversations-db.ts (listConversations, listActiveConversations, getConversationByName, and any others) or the field silently reads as undefined.
hazards.mitigation: Foundation bead enumerates all read sites; inspection gate verifies the field is threaded through every SELECT + mapper + the Conversation TS interface and surfaced in GET /api/conversations.

hazards.summary: Schema migration must be append-only and idempotent. SCHEMA_VERSION is 48; the new column is migration v49 plus addition to the CREATE TABLE for fresh DBs.
hazards.mitigation: Add `if (currentVersion < 49) { ALTER TABLE conversations ADD COLUMN project_key TEXT }`, add the column to the inline CREATE TABLE, and bump SCHEMA_VERSION to 49. Wrap the ALTER in try/catch per the existing pattern.

hazards.summary: The frontend groups conversations by `cwd`→project-path prefix (`isUnscopedConversation` in projectsData.ts). If grouping is not updated to prefer the override, a moved conversation will visually snap back to its cwd-derived project.
hazards.mitigation: Frontend foundation bead changes grouping to read `projectKey` first and fall back to cwd inference; covered by a grouping-precedence unit test.

hazards.summary: CLI move requires the dashboard to be running (it calls the HTTP endpoint). If the dashboard is down the command must fail clearly, not silently no-op.
hazards.mitigation: On fetch failure / non-2xx, print a clear chalk.red message and exit non-zero, matching the abort-review/reset-review error convention.

hazards.summary: Browser UAT for the two UI surfaces (drag-drop + menu picker) must run in an isolated Playwright instance/profile and not depend on another agent's browser session.
hazards.mitigation: Acceptance criteria for the test role specify isolated-profile Playwright UAT: drag a conversation onto a project and verify re-group; open the 3-dot Move picker and verify the move + toast.

sessionHistory.note: Auto-mode planning for PAN-1577: move a conversation to a different project (CLI + drag/drop + menu action). Established the override-column architecture, the single move endpoint primitive, CLI/HTTP wiring, and a 9-bead decomposition across persistence, contracts, endpoint, CLI, skill, and four frontend beads.

No deviations from the xBRIEF's actual intent, but the plan's file references were stale on 3 of 6 items (written before recent refactors) and I adapted rather than following them literally: (1) persist-project-key targeted src/lib/database/{schema,conversations-db}.ts, which has zero production importers -- implemented on the live overdeck.db module (src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts) instead. (2) menu-move assumed ConversationActionMenu.tsx is shared by the 3-dot menu and row right-click; it isn't -- that's only used by the Stage pane-tab menu. Added Move to ConversationRow's actual per-row menu (and to ConversationActionMenu too, for consistency). (3) drag-drop-move named ProjectTree/ProjectNode.tsx as the drop target; that component only ever renders the single currently-selected project's detail view, so it can never be a cross-project drop target -- used the Sidebar's persistent project rail instead, which lists every project simultaneously.

Also found and reported (not fixed, outside PAN-1577 scope) a fleet-wide state-door outage on the shared overdeck-state worktree: 15 untracked stray draft files blocking every 'pan task claim/done' push across the pipeline, 663 unpushed commits with 612 accumulated restore-commit pairs. Flagged via pan tell; it resolved on its own partway through this session (unclear who/what fixed it).

All 6 xBRIEF items complete: project_key override column + reads (overdeck.db), conversation.moved domain event, PATCH /api/conversations/:name/move endpoint, frontend grouping precedence (projectKey over cwd), pan conversations move CLI command + pan-conversations skill, shared optimistic move mutation, Move-with-picker in both conversation menus, and native drag-and-drop onto the sidebar project rail.

Full monorepo npm test caught 3 real gaps from my changes (all now fixed): two locked no-loss-audit surfaces needed explicit entries for the new PATCH route, and a skill-set fixture needed regenerating for the new pan-conversations skill. Verified with two full test runs during quieter load and targeted reruns of every affected file; the only test-suite noise seen was environmental -- this machine is at load average 24+ with swap near-exhausted from ~24 other concurrently-running agents, which produces widespread beforeEach hook timeouts unrelated to this branch (confirmed by isolated reruns passing cleanly).

AC4 (browser UAT of both move flows end-to-end) was verified for real: built this branch, ran the dashboard against an isolated throwaway OVERDECK_HOME/port with the deacon disabled (no production interference), and drove both the menu-picker move and native drag-and-drop via a real Playwright session. All 8 scripted checks passed, confirmed by screenshots (sent to the operator) and server-side API verification.

Investigated the 'test' verification failure before touching any code. GitHub CI's own test check is SUCCESS on the exact commit this gate ran against (c271379b44, matching the PR's headRefOid). The gate's own captured output shows 'Test Files 165 passed (165), Tests 1880 passed (1880)' -- zero failures anywhere in the actual summary; the confusing [prep] sync-main/state-reconcile/feature-pan-1141 lines are verbose console output from an auto-resume-gating test fixture in this repo's own suite (uses feature-pan-1141 as synthetic fixture data) plus normal pan sync-main prep logging, not a real defect. I ran the full npm test suite twice earlier this session (once clean, once under this box's current severe load -- average 24+, swap near-exhausted from ~24 concurrently-running agents) and every file touched by this branch passes consistently in isolation regardless of load. Nothing in my code needed changing; resubmitting to get a fresh, hopefully less contended, verification pass. Only new commits since prior submission are an automatic origin/main sync (a flywheel docs tick + the resulting merge), no PAN-1577 code changes.

Commits a10f31d, be9cf7d (file-size allowlist bump).

moved-event.reason: Added conversation.moved event to packages/contracts/src/events.ts (Schema.Struct mirroring conversation.created, added to DomainEvent union) and a reducer case in event-reducers.ts bumping conversationsListRevision. Contracts build clean, full typecheck + lint pass with no new errors. Commit c295eaf.

move-endpoint.reason: Added PATCH /api/conversations/:name/move. Logic lives in handleConversationMove (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-reads.ts), mirroring patchConversationTitle; route in conversations.ts just delegates. Covers all 5 ACs: 200+updated conv, 404 unknown conv, 400 'Unknown project: <key>' for both unregistered-key and missing-path cases, 200 no-op+no-emit when already in target project, conversation.moved emitted with {conversationName,projectKey} on real moves, and a dedicated test asserting cwd + claudeSessionId (JSONL pointer) unchanged after move. 7 new tests pass, full typecheck/lint clean, file-size allowlist bumped for routes/conversations.ts (1004->1029, over the 1000 ceiling). Commit 6d0b238.

frontend-grouping-foundation.reason: Conversation type gains projectKey (ConversationList.tsx). isUnscopedConversation, resolveConversationProjectName, and the projectConversations bucketing loop in CommandDeck/index.tsx all check the override first, falling back to cwd inference only when null -- unit-tested precedence (5 new tests in projectsData.test.ts covering override-wins, override-set-but-unmatched=unscoped, null-falls-back-to-cwd, no-match, neither-set). ac2 (live re-group on conversation.moved) was already satisfied by the moved-event item's reducer case bumping conversationsListRevision, which ConversationList's existing effect already invalidates the ['conversations'] query on. Full frontend typecheck/lint clean, 458 CommandDeck tests + 14 Sidebar tests pass with no regressions. File-size allowlist bumped for CommandDeck/index.tsx (1597->1618). Commit 2c30e8d.

cli-move.reason: Added pan conversations move <query> <projectKey>. Resolver: exact getConversationByName first, then unique fuzzy title match over listConversations(); non-zero exit with clear message for no-match or ambiguous match (lists candidates). PATCHes the move endpoint via getDashboardApiUrlSync, prints resolved title + old->new project labels (via getProjectSync name lookup), handles ECONNREFUSED as 'Dashboard not running'. Follows show.ts/reset-review.ts chalk+exitCli conventions. 8 new tests (exact match, fuzzy match, success labels, no-match, ambiguous, unknown-project, dashboard-down, command registration) all pass; typecheck/lint clean. Commit ccca029.

move-mutation.reason: Added move({name, projectKey, projectName}) to useConversationMutations following the favoriteMutation pattern: onMutate cancels+optimistically patches projectKey in the ['conversations'] cache (captures title before the patch for the success toast, matching AC's 'title not id' requirement); onError rolls back from context + toast.error(server message); onSuccess toast.success('Moved <title> to <project>'); onSettled invalidates. 4 new tests: optimistic-apply, rollback-on-error, title-based success toast, settle-invalidation. Full CommandDeck suite (462 tests) passes with no regressions, typecheck/lint clean.

cli-skill.reason: Created sync-sources/skills/pan-conversations/SKILL.md documenting all 9 subcommands (scan/search/list/show/jsonl/move/current/cost/embed/enrich) matching --help output exactly. Adding 'move' to the CLI in the prior commit had drifted packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts (caught by lint:slash-commands under full npm run lint); regenerated via npm run generate:slash-commands and included here. scripts/lint-skills.sh and full npm run lint pass clean. Commit 5abf57e2.

menu-move.reason: Added Move item + project-picker submenu to ConversationRow's 3-dot/right-click menu (the actual per-row menu; discovered ConversationActionMenu.tsx is NOT shared with it as the xBRIEF assumed -- it's only used by the Stage pane-tab context menu, so added Move there too for consistency). Current project (conversation.projectKey) is indicated+disabled in the picker; selecting another calls mutations.move. Registered-projects lifted to ConversationList level and passed as a prop (avoids N duplicate per-row fetches; fixed a pre-existing fetch-count test by pre-seeding the query in the shared test client helper). 4 new tests (3-dot picker, right-click picker, current-project disabled, mutation fires on select); full CommandDeck suite (466 tests) passes; typecheck/lint clean. Commit d520d87.

drag-drop-move.reason: ConversationRow is a native HTML5 drag source (draggable, cursor:grab, onDragStart carries {name,projectKey} JSON). Drop target is the Sidebar's persistent project rail button (NOT ProjectTree/ProjectNode.tsx as the xBRIEF assumed -- that component only ever renders the single currently-selected project's detail tree, so it can never be a cross-project drop target; the sidebar rail lists every registered project simultaneously, which is what a user would actually drag onto). onDragOver highlights the hovered project (ring-2), onDrop calls the shared move mutation unless payload.projectKey already matches the target (no-op, no mutation call). 7 new Vitest tests (drag payload, highlight+clear, mutation-fires, no-op). Full frontend suite passes (2900/2901; 1 pre-existing unrelated failure in tiered-crews.test.ts, a model-pricing assertion untouched by this branch). AC4 (browser UAT of both flows end-to-end) verified via a real isolated Playwright run against this branch's built dist, using its own throwaway OVERDECK_HOME/port with the deacon disabled (no production interference): all 8 checks passed -- menu-picker move (TestProj->SecondProj) and native drag-drop (SecondProj->TestProj), each confirmed via visible success toast AND server-side projectKey verification through the API. Screenshots sent to the operator. Commit 99a6422.
